tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: Aluminium is usually found in <math><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></math> oxidation state. In contrast, thallium exists in <math><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></math> and <math><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></math> oxidation states. This is due to:

solution.text: Reluctance in tendency of s-electrons to participate in bonding on moving top to bottom in p-block elements is called inert pair effect. Due to inert pair effect <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></math> is very unstable in aluminium.
